review_notes: I read the whole file and compared proofs within it against each other and against the imported FS81 Layer file. I also looked at GGNbrBalanceBasic and TableC/HypLeaves. The only repeated nontrivial machinery I found is the "3 divides card, so not contained in the p-prime core" argument. The two quasisimple-subnormal-to-GLAPComponent blocks at lines 41-51 and 66-82 are also similar, but I didn't report them: the saving is a few lines and a helper would be a thin wrapper. The paired hb0ne/hb2ne and hb0pow/hb2pow blocks in the last theorem are short routine calculations. I did not compile the replacement. One uncertainty is whether `Fact (Nat.Prime 3)` is already available as an instance in this context. Otherwise it needs a local `haveI`.

        (inferInstance : Finite G) C
    exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd Nat.prime_three).mp hcop
      (h3K.trans (Subgroup.card_dvd_of_le hle))
findings.problem: hKnot reproves from scratch that a subgroup whose order is divisible by 3 is not contained in `lBalancePrimeCore 3 C`. It takes the coprimality of the prime core, then uses coprime_iff_not_dvd, and finally `card_dvd_of_le`. The same argument appears in `nineJ_not_le_primeCore` (TwD5Nine92Layer.lean, lines 92-99, the 3 ∣ 6 variant) and in TableC/HypLeaves.lean (lines 53-60). The general lemma `CFSG.StandardType.not_le_lBalancePrimeCore_of_dvd` already states it as `p ∣ Nat.card A → ¬ A ≤ lBalancePrimeCore p Y`. GGNbrBalanceBasic is already a transitive import through TwD5Nine92Layer. Because the argument is open-coded, the `@primeCore_coprime ... ⟨Nat.prime_three⟩` instance plumbing is also repeated.
findings.proposed_change: Replace lines 72-78 with `have hKnot : ¬ K ≤ CFSG.Open.lBalancePrimeCore 3 C := by haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨Nat.prime_three⟩; exact CFSG.StandardType.not_le_lBalancePrimeCore_of_dvd h3K`. Similarly, `nineJ_not_le_primeCore` in the Layer file could be reduced to `not_le_lBalancePrimeCore_of_dvd` applied to `(dvd_trans (by norm_num : 3 ∣ 6) h6)`. Optionally, `nineJ_primeCore_eq_bot` (lines 156-170) could use an analogous `Fact`-based lemma stated for `GLAPPrimeCore`, which would remove its copy of the same coprime/not-dvd step.
findings.benefit: This removes a copy of the coprime/not-dvd argument and the `@`-explicit instance passing. The step then has one maintained statement, so a change to the prime-core API only needs fixing in one place. The proof of hKnot becomes two lines and its intent is clearer.
